non_markov_pass_evidence.interpretation: Raw-MIDI repair interleaves first-pass and replay strands in rendered-event order; one scalar current-pass state is not a valid Markov representation.

complexity_blocker.gold_guarantee: Requires retaining jumps through ±171, all observed span widths through 136, and concurrent pass strands.
complexity_blocker.sparse_bound_failure: A ±70 bound drops train gold transitions; full bounds approach dense all-score connectivity.
complexity_blocker.single_pass_state_failure: Observed 0->2 and 2->1 transitions violate a sequential 0->1->2->0 pass machine even though provenance is valid.
complexity_blocker.required_state: Concurrent-strand/set-valued replay state with per-strand cursor and copy pass, plus event ownership.
complexity_blocker.consequence: The requested bounded-reorder single-identity CRF cannot simultaneously be sparse and guarantee gold retention.

next_technical_implication: Canonical supervision must expose renderer strand/voice ownership, or the model must use a factorial/multi-strand CRF. Training another single-cursor CRF would silently exclude valid gold paths.
